watch: Whether the 1.2 GW Texas project converts from 'aligned on principal commercial terms' to a signed agreement, and whether the hyperscaler is finally named. NRG's stated 2026 goal was to sign at least 1 GW under the Bring Your Own Power model; disclosed economics are about $3.2 billion at roughly $2,700/kW, about $500M annual adjusted EBITDA, about $375M FCF before growth, a 12-15 percent pre-tax unlevered IRR and a late-2029 COD, expandable to 2.4 GW

A firm turbine purchase order or a final investment decision under the GE Vernova and TIC Project Development Agreement. Slot reservations went 1.2 GW (Feb 2025) to 3.6 GW (FY2025 10-K) against an unchanged 5.4 GW ceiling; GE Vernova accounts for reservations separately from backlog. No site has ever been named. NOTE: this is a development agreement, not a joint venture — NRG's filings never use that phrase

The ERCOT interconnection audit ordered 2026-08-03 and its December 2026 verification report. NRG's signed 445 MW of data-centre retail agreements are grid-served and therefore exposed; behind-the-meter generation is exempt, which favours the BYOP model

The Texas residential electricity customer count: 2,928 to 2,909 to 2,860 thousand across three years. A fourth consecutive decline would make the retail erosion structural. Watch it alongside Vivint subscribers (2,111 to 2,226 to 2,419 thousand) and the provision for credit losses ($251M, $314M, $272M)

LS Power integration and its shareholding: the deal closed 2026-01-30 at $10,583M plus about $3.2bn of assumed debt; LS Power retains roughly 11 percent of NRG with voting capped at 10 percent through a trust, and sold 12.3 million shares in a March 2026 secondary. Purchase-price allocation is to be finalised by end-2026; goodwill is $3,802M preliminarily split $1,588M Texas / $2,214M East

The two remaining Texas Energy Fund projects: Cedar Bayou 5 (689 MW) and Greens Bayou 6 (443 MW), both mid-2028, on $562M and $370M of 3 percent loans. T.H. Wharton reached commercial operation 2026-05-26 with a completion-bonus grant agreement of up to $54.72M over ten instalments from 2027

Guidance credibility: two consecutive adjusted-EPS misses in 2026, both at exactly $1.49, against reaffirmed full-year guidance of $7.90-$9.90. First-half adjusted EPS of about $2.98 implies a heavily back-loaded year, and the $2.00-wide range is unusually loose

The valuation gap: a 52-week low of $111.85 on 2026-08-24 against a mean target near $189 and 13 of 16 ratings still Buy or Strong Buy. Every August broker action was a target cut without a rating change

Consumer-protection exposure: the $71 million New York PSC settlement approved 2026-04-16 across nine NRG-affiliated brands and about 278,000 customers (Case 25-M-0516). Watch for similar actions in other states

Chesterton check: investors.nrg.com is 403/503-blocked, so the percentage of expected generation hedged — a figure both Vistra and Talen publish — is unobtainable for NRG, as is any net leverage ratio.
